newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Antena 3 sold 13% stake to Int'l investors.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Antena 3 sold 13% stake to Int'l investors.

text.p: Spain's Antena 3 Television said on Friday it had sold a 13 percent stake of its capital to a group of international investors.
The statement added that the operation was coordinated by SBC Warburg. It also said that the group bought the stake in the form of American Depositary Receipts.
The average annual audience share of Antena 3 was around 25 percent in 1996. It ended 1996 with advertising sales of 75 billion pesetas and net profit of seven billion pesetas.
Last April, Antena 3 had 5.545 billion pesetas of pretax profit and advertising sales of 70.833 billion.
Since 1992 Antena 3 has been owned by its chairman Antonio Asensio.
